root_cause_lessons.lesson: A long-lived conversation shell can reach a hard product limit while durable Home/Mission state remains valid; continuity must migrate across shells rather than depending on one chat forever.
Remaining active longer can improve opportunity for work, but elapsed runtime, conversation age, heartbeat, poll and retry do not themselves create learning credit.
Apparent faster development is not a causal speedup claim until comparable durable-progress, cycle latency, rework and recovery samples accumulate.
A new chat shell must inherit only durable pointers and verified baselines. It must not reconstruct identity by rereading the entire old chat.
